- **Step 1 (Internal Pathway — FSSAI Ayush-Aahar / Nutraceutical)**: *Kalpvriksh Satva 7-Tulsi Cellular Reset Drops (30 ml | ₹499)* — 9.0 ml active liquid extract per 10 ml across 7 Sacred Tulsi chemotypes (Van, Sweet, Marua, Bisva, Kala, Rama, Lemon Tulsi). Rich in standardized Eugenol (≥42%), Rosmarinic Acid (≥18%), and Ursolic Acid (≥12%) to downregulate intestinal COX-2, seal gut mucosal tight junctions (ZO-1/occludin), halt lipopolysaccharide (LPS) endotoxemia, and suppress systemic TNF-α, IL-6, and IL-17 cytokines.
- **Step 2 (External Pathway — AYUSH / Cosmetics Rules, 2020)**: *Himalayan Sea Buckthorn Postbiotic Cellular Emulsion (100 ml | ₹799)* — 4.0% wild Himalayan Sea Buckthorn extract (harvested >11,000 ft in Ladakh & Spiti, sub-28°C cold-extracted, rich in Omega-7 palmitoleic acid & native bio-ferulic acid), 5.0% Botanical Glycerin, 1.5% Postbiotic Lactobacillus Ferment, 0.5% Manjistha, 0.5% Haridra, 0.5% Neem, 0.5% Cucumber, 0.1% Hyaluronic Acid, and 0.1% Niacinamide in a non-stripping glucoside emulsion at pH 5.3–5.5.
